editorial_metadata.methodology_summary: PropScore is algorithmic on a 0-97 scale; verified trader reviews dominate, payout reliability has the greatest weight, with smaller adjustments for external trust signals and recent momentum. Rankings cannot be bought and commercial relationships do not influence scores.
Rule fairness; Payout reliability; Cost efficiency; Trader sentiment; Platform quality
The site says it tests, analyses and reviews leading proprietary trading firms and provides real reviews, rankings and side-by-side analyses.

PropScore is a daily 0-100 algorithm using seven criteria and 100 total points; criteria include price, profit split, rules, platforms, trust signals and evidence quality. Health Score measures payout reliability, Trustpilot quality, community sentiment and operational stability.
Analysts read the rulebook, price plans, check payout evidence in a verified feed and state who the firm suits; reviews are separate from trader-written reviews.
Uses the live PropScore as a ranking signal and directs readers to the live seven-criteria methodology; also uses Health Score for Trustpilot trends, Reddit complaints and payout transparency.
The article emphasizes futures-specific execution, exchange-traded contracts, drawdown type and futures platform ecosystems when comparing firms.
Beginner criteria include static or balance-based drawdown, no evaluation time limits, transparent rules, verifiable payouts, reasonable pricing and usable platforms.
US comparison considers US acceptance, CFTC-compliant platform access, futures suitability and the continuing limitations on CFD platforms.
challenge rules and requirements; fees and pricing; profit share and payout structures; platform reputation and reviews; trading platforms and tools

Ranked by verified Trustpilot ratings and reviews; Comparison includes funding, profit share, and trading platforms; Trustpilot rating and track record are emphasized; firms with 4.5+ ratings and at least 3 years in operation are described as proven reliability signals.
